statement: Resolve a beep-boop Tone from a PCS prompt-generation payload. Read tone from variables_resolved, then metadata, then context_used, then a top-level tone field. Known Tone values and the aliases matter-of-fact and shamanic-esoteric map to the enum. A missing key, unknown string, empty value, transport error, or non-200 response falls back to Tone.CONVERSATIONAL and does not include the PCS API key in the reason.

expected_io.returns: tone=Tone.CONVERSATIONAL, source=fallback, reason starts with pcs_unavailable
source=fallback and the resolution reason does not contain the API key
